scope: CPU-only native-to-registry expression projection for the frozen referent target-rank audit; no model forward, native score, GPU execution, queue mutation, admission, or efficacy claim

projection_contract.physical_identity: exact scene, ann_id, dataset_index, and expression_slot join
projection_contract.registry_scope: all and only primary_rank_eligible expressions must be present
projection_contract.query_order: sampled_seed_indices, confidence scores, and IoU values remain on the native query axis
projection_contract.referent_cost: negative native objectness confidence; lower is better
projection_contract.objectness_cost: one minus native candidate mask IoU; lower is better
identity_checks: capture model class, config path, config hash, producer hash, model source hash, and checkpoint hash
query seed indices inside exact native superpoint support
finite probabilities for confidence and IoU axes
projection_contract.missing_data_policy: reject before object-rank capture construction; no imputation

status.stage_completed: Fail-closed native capture to frozen expression-contract projection
status.next_action: When GPU7 capacity opens, run the frozen M95 native capture, project its rows with referent_native_expression_producer_20260919.py, build the object-rank capture, and evaluate without imputation.

limitations: Unit tests validate the static projection boundary, not model quality or scientific validity.
No native capture, candidate coverage count, target rank, or efficacy result exists.
The fixed TRAIN cohort is diagnostic and not a held-out population sample.
The projection enforces complete rank-eligible coverage and rejects the whole projection if an expression is absent.
